lines.zh: 它沿着菌丝爬，六足几乎没有声。
lines.en: It climbs along the mycelium, six feet nearly silent.

lines.zh: 它倒挂在洞顶，慢慢横移。
lines.en: It hangs from the cave roof and sidles along.

lines.zh: 它一步一停，学着你走路的节奏。
lines.en: It stops at every step, copying your pace.

lines.zh: 它折起镰刀臂，钻进窄缝。
lines.en: It folds its scythe arms and slips into a crevice.

lines.zh: 它在苔藓上留下细长的印。
lines.en: It leaves a long thin print in the moss.

lines.zh: 它从一丛腐菌跳到另一丛。
lines.en: It springs from one clump of rotting fungus to the next.

lines.zh: 我伏在蕨叶间，前臂收着。
lines.en: Lying in the ferns, my forearms folded.
I hang from the cave roof, waiting for steps.

lines.zh: 它把前臂举在胸前，一动不动。
lines.en: It holds its forearms at its chest, unmoving.

lines.zh: 它用触须试洞里的气流。
lines.en: It tests the cave's airflow with its antennae.

lines.zh: 洞里最多三只，我是第一只。
lines.en: Three at most in this cave, and I am first.

lines.zh: 它的复眼把你的火光滑成一片。
lines.en: Its compound eyes smear your torchlight into one sheet.
A tear in my wing; I can't fly.

lines.zh: 我的前肢举着，还没砍下。
lines.en: My forelegs are raised, not yet swung.
Reach over; my scythes are waiting.

lines.zh: 别靠近我，否则你会遭殃！
lines.en: Stay away or you’ll be sorry!
Don’t even think about eating me!

lines.zh: 我不出手，先看你怎么动。
lines.en: I hold back and watch how you move.

lines.zh: 我在这洞穴里蹲了很久。
lines.en: I've crouched in this cave a long time.

lines.zh: 我的预知之眼可以看见你！
lines.en: My foresight eye can see you!
Bump me and my scythes rise.
Don't touch my plates; they cut.

lines.zh: 我举着臂，等你再靠近一格。
lines.en: Arms raised, waiting for you to come one block closer.

lines.zh: 找到我，你就是我的伴侣！
lines.en: Find me, and you’re my mate!

lines.zh: 腐化洞穴里，也该有后代。
lines.en: Even a corrupted cave needs offspring.

lines.zh: 腐化真菌的洞里，只容得下我们两只。
lines.en: This fungal cave only fits the two of us.

lines.zh: 我感觉到了你的存在，别动！

lines.en: You can't escape, the mantis is here!
腐化之地 is my domain!

lines.zh: 洞里只能容三只，我们够用了。
lines.en: The cave holds three of us; that is enough.

lines.zh: 这片腐化土地归我，别蹲下。
lines.en: This corrupted ground is mine; do not crouch.

lines.zh: 别想逃！我已经盯上你了！

lines.en: Stay out, this is my home!
You can't escape, the mantis is here! — Mantis, target acquire

lines.zh: 你踩断的枯枝，我听见了。
lines.en: I heard the twig you snapped.

lines.zh: 你跟得太深了，它记下了。
lines.en: You went too deep, and it took note.

lines.zh: 它数着洞里的第三个人。
lines.en: It counts the third person in this cave.

lines.zh: 我在洞顶等，你走过来了。
lines.en: I waited on the ceiling, and you walked in.

lines.zh: 镰刀臂收到肩后，等你走。
lines.en: Scythe arms folded back, I wait for your step.
It draws its scythe arms back past its shoulders.
It judges the gap between you and the cave wall.
It lowers itself, wings half open.

lines.zh: 它等你背对腐菌的那一刻。
lines.en: It waits for the moment you turn from the fungus.

lines.zh: 它的头偏了三寸，对准脖子。
lines.en: Its head tilts three inches and lines up on your neck.

lines.zh: 它把前足钉进苔藓里稳住。
lines.en: It digs its forefeet into the moss for grip.
Swing arms to slash you down.

lines.zh: 敏捷地挥动双臂，伺机而动。
lines.en: Swiftly swing arms, waiting for the chance.

lines.zh: 双臂蓄势待发，准备一击毙命。
lines.en: Arms ready, ready for a lethal strike.
Swing arms to knock you down.

lines.zh: 双臂挥动，砍向你的要害。
lines.en: Swing arms to strike your vital spot.

lines.zh: 双臂挥舞，试图将你劈倒。
lines.en: Swing arms to knock you down.
Swing arms to knock you down.
Lurk in the cave depths, waiting.
In the corrupt lands, I wait.
In the corrupt lands, I wait for the chance.

lines.zh: 等待玩家进入，我便现身。
lines.en: Wait for you to enter, then appear.
In the corrupt lands, I wait.

lines.zh: 腐菌丛动了一下，那里多了一只。
lines.en: The rotten fungus stirs, and one more is there.

lines.zh: 洞顶落下一层孢子，它下来了。
lines.en: Spores sift from the roof, and down it comes.
